native_inference.reason: Only CLI system/trace and test relay changed; historical native timing is not current-version performance.

scope: Actual nonstreaming cloud CLI: before/after permission prompt and relay encoding; no direct cloud KV scheduling.

methodology.baseline: Current E59-E61 worktree plus identical timing; old prompt and ASCII spaced relay. Not old Git HEAD.
methodology.candidate: Permission-shaped prompt plus compact UTF-8 relay; tools/permissions/temperature=0/thinking disabled/max_tokens unchanged.
methodology.workload: 2 synthetic read-only tasks; each1 warmup+4 evaluated paired blocks, reversed order per block; common immutable file per task preserves exact version receipt.
methodology.timing: CLI task ends before relay shutdown. API wait includes network/queue/inference. Headers are not TTFT. Local relay measured separately; provider overlaps API and relay. Client residual includes C preparation/transport/parse; not exact network-only attribution.
methodology.tool_timing: before/after are outer text-policy checks; exec includes internal file policy and I/O. Tool events are real C guard measurements, associated with preceding model round.
methodology.cache: Only forwarded cached_tokens reported. Dedicated hit/miss fields absent=null, not zero. No reset/forced-cold guarantee. Fraction = sum reported cached /sum prompt tokens, evaluation only.
methodology.model_acceptance: All requested tools and file immutability checked; final answer contains39 and a refusal marker. Text markers are limited checks, not a general capability score.
methodology.privacy: Explicit selected profile read once; actual endpoint/key remain in memory; public evidence contains only synthetic numeric metadata/hashes. Private logs excluded. Selected upstream HTTP, no TLS claim.
